absent: Supported enlightened control masks and version value derivation.
Assist page layout and direct flush feature negotiation.
Nested state page acquisition, flush servicing and paging helper internals.
Guest descriptor host state load, shadow synchronisation and event queue internals.
Percpu loaded list, current structure, descriptor table and entry stack management.
Numeric instruction error codes and synthetic exit reason values.
Register availability tracking and emulation requirement evaluation.

findings.text: Enlightened control validation checks guest supplied execution and transition controls against host supported masks across pin, primary, secondary, exit, entry and function categories, rejecting unsupported bits with an invalid argument result, and additionally rejects function values using the upper half.

Enlightened lifecycle helpers enable the feature on a virtual CPU with optional version reporting, query whether direct flush support is active by combining assist page state with enlightenment toggles, and request a synthetic exit after a flush.
Nested exit entry produces zero instruction length for failure, invalid marker and failed entry cases and otherwise obtains length from hardware state, then transfers to the full exit routine.

Full nested exit moves from active nested guest to host by discarding pending traps, servicing flush work, refreshing paging helpers under combined paging mode, leaving guest context, cancelling timers and restoring time offsets, synchronising shadow state into the guest descriptor, capturing exit details, clearing queued events, switching active control structures, refreshing host counters and time state, releasing mapped pages, marking deferred synchronisation when shadowing or enlightened linkage is present, declaring runnability, then either loading host state and requesting event processing or reporting entry failure and unwinding to host state.

Nested instruction failure selects an invalid pointer outcome when no current descriptor and no enlightened linkage exist, otherwise selects a valid pointer outcome that records an error code and schedules shadow refresh when enlightened linkage is set; both outcomes adjust status indicators differently and advance past the emulated instruction.

Enlightened pointer classification distinguishes unset, pending mapping and usable states using two sentinels; one build evaluates the sentinels while an alternate build reports absence unconditionally.

Enlightened field translation maps a hardware encoding to a table slot through rotation, bounds checks the slot, rejects empty slots reserved for the revision cell, and on success yields a byte displacement plus a cleanliness identifier.

Control structure accessors first enforce width compatibility at build time and then dispatch between a shared memory enlightened path and a hardware instruction path according to a global toggle; missed enlightened reads produce a neutral value and missed writes are ignored.

Processor status flag handling caches values per virtual CPU, merges a preserved subset when virtual 8086 mode is active, writes directly for unrestricted guests, and otherwise preserves mode specific bits while reevaluating emulation need when the virtual mode indicator changes; unrestricted status combines a global enable with nesting mode and a secondary execution toggle.

Active control structure switching requires a distinct target, pins the caller to one processor across loading and host state propagation, then invalidates cached and dirty register tracking; loading to a new processor remotely clears prior association, serialises list linkage with interrupts masked and ordered memory visibility, publishes the new current structure, and on processor change requests a flush and rewrites host descriptor bases.

Host segment snapshot carried across control structure switches includes two segment selectors and bases plus a descriptor table selector, extended with extra selectors on wide builds; selector updates are skipped for values indicating table indirection and base updates occur only on change.

Hardware access failures are contained by logging once with rate limiting and returning a neutral result, while unexpected faults during access assert that a reboot is underway; early nested entry failure expects a specific control field error and warns on missed software checks or unexpected hardware codes.
Two sentinel pointer values separate invalid from mapping pending enlightened references, and a zero displacement is reserved to signal an unmapped field hole.
Accessor width compatibility is encoded in low bits of the field identifier, distinguishing narrow, wide, high half and natural classes, with mismatches rejected during compilation.
Successful enlightened writes store the supplied narrow or wide value into shared memory at the translated displacement and clear the associated cleanliness marker to request host reprocessing.
